_purpose: Headline figures quoted in user-facing documentation, with how each was obtained. The README once claimed '3 minutes' and 'a handful of claims' for a run that actually took 4.9 minutes and produced 72 -- both errors flattering the tool. Numbers in prose must come from here, and a test asserts the README matches.
_caveat: Single runs on one machine with one model set. Treat as the right order of magnitude, not as a specification. Different hardware or models will differ substantially.

spoken_talk_ingest.source: a 25-minute talk, 21 KB of transcript after flattening captions
spoken_talk_ingest.how: winnow ingest against a fresh corpus, wall-clock timed, defaults unchanged

dedupe_scan_cost.example: ~390 ms per insert at 10,000 stored claims
dedupe_scan_cost.note: grows linearly per claim, so a run's total scanning grows quadratically

projection_accuracy.how: projected vs wall-clock for a 200-300 file index at each corpus size

chunk_size_coverage.note: coverage is relative to the union of settings tested, never to what exists

faithfulness.local_judge_distortions_caught: 0 of 3, under two opposite prompt designs
faithfulness.how: experiments/CORRECTNESS.md -- the 88% is 22 of 25 claims graded one by one against the source by a frontier model (Claude Opus 5), NOT by a human; the 98% is the local judge's own score on all 85, withdrawn
faithfulness.local_judge_status: WITHDRAWN. 83 of 85 claims marked SUPPORTED by gemma3:27b, but it marked all three known distortions SUPPORTED too, so the number measures agreeableness, not faithfulness.

quickstart.source: fresh clone, empty corpus, README quickstart followed exactly
quickstart.how: timed end to end on the hardware above; corpus deleted first and verified empty

full_starter_corpus.what_was_claimed: 337 files, about 3.5 hours -- quoted in the README and, as 'Measured:', in docs/DOMAIN_PACKS.md
full_starter_corpus.why_withdrawn: The hours were derived by multiplying a file count by a per-page ESTIMATE of 30-40 seconds, then presented as a measurement. The only measured indexing run here is the quickstart's 80 files in 479s (6.0 s/file), which extrapolates to about 34 minutes for 337 -- six times smaller. Both cannot be right.
full_starter_corpus.how: not measured: it needs a full fetch and a full index, neither of which has been run here. The tool's own cost gate answers this question per-machine, which is why no figure is quoted in its place.
